title: Industry Report | 2022 Overseas Influencer Marketing Benchmark — $16.4B Market
summary: Unique Research digest of Influencer Marketing Hub × Refersion State of Influencer Marketing 2022. Global influencer marketing market → ~$16.4B in 2022 (from $1.7B ’16 / $13.8B ’21, +19%). Related firms +26% to 18,900 (US +30%). Influencer software platforms raised >$800M in ’21
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Benchmark · July 6, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

Unique Research digest of Influencer Marketing Hub × Refersion State of Influencer Marketing 2022. Global influencer marketing market → ~$16.4B in 2022 (from $1.7B ’16 / $13.8B ’21, +19%). Related firms +26% to 18,900 (US +30%). Influencer software platforms raised >$800M in ’21 (CreatorIQ $40M, Tagger $23.5M…). Ad-block use +9% YoY; desktop block rate >43%. Social commerce sales ’22 ~$958B → $2.9T by ’26; US $51.2B (6.9% share). Creator economy ~$104B; >$1.3B VC in ’21 (Kajabi $550M @ $2B; Cameo $166M @ $1B; Substack $82M @ $650M). 77% brands set influencer budgets; most spend <$50k, ~4% >$500k. Full tables in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
